text:
Priya S: Heads up — sketching a compact design partners run for infra-focused customers. Idea: 6 partners, 6-week cycles, weekly async updates + one 30m retro. Aim is to validate rollout guardrails (pinning, fallback policies, cost controls). Thoughts?
Mateo R: love smaller cohort for speed. can we make one of the partners a marketplace customer? they'd stress routing policies.
Zoe L: +1. also want explicit success criteria: e.g., 95th p50 latency within Xms, two validated fallback flows, signal-driven alerting working.
Alex H: agree on measurable gates. propose adding a recruitment filter for "ops-minded" contacts (SRE/infra) — they'll give config + perf feedback.
Priya S: good call. recruitment checklist draft below:

- must be running >= 1k req/day of inference workload
- willing to share perf traces (anonymized)
- agree to 1x canary route for 2 weeks
- commit to completing two short eval prompts each week

Mateo R: can we make the "two short eval prompts" a small litmus test we auto-check? e.g. run eval job and report metrics back. less manual.
Zoe L: yes, automate. sample eval job:```bash
redwood eval run --suite dp-basic-latency --output s3://dp-results/{{partner}}/week-{{n}}
```
that way we get consistent artifacts.
Jamal K: what about incentives? partners tend to drop off if it's too heavy. suggest $2k credit + 2 dev hours of SE time per partner.
Priya S: noted. also thinking about a microtask flow for partners: short weekly checklist via Google Form + automated Slack DM reminders. keeps async load light.
Alex H: workflow for feedback routing? we should avoid one-off PM inbox. propose triage channel per partner + tagging schema: `#dp/<partner-name>` and use reactions to mark severity (:warning: high, :white_check_mark: resolved).
Mateo R: could we add an ops-bot step that takes form responses and files a concise issue with labels: `dp/partner`, `area:serving`, `severity:low|med|high`?
ops-bot: will implement a zap: form -> webhook -> create GitHub issue with template. ETA: 3 days.
Zoe L: scaffolding for issue template (short):```
Title: [DP] {{partner}} - {{short-summary}}
Labels: dp/partner, area:serving, severity:{{severity}}
Body:
- Steps to reproduce:
- Expected behavior:
- Observed behavior:
- Attachments: perf artifacts link
```
Priya S: love that. success criteria (proposal):
- 4/6 partners finish 6-week program
- For at least 3 partners we have end-to-end validated fallback policy (test triggers + observed graceful degrade)
- Quantified unit-cost improvement suggestions from Optimize tool for at least 2 partners
- No P0 incidents introduced by rollout (any regressions must be reversible by config)

Jamal K: timeline ask — can we pilot this in June? recruiting in May.
Priya S: June pilot timeline works if recruiting starts now. Mateo, can you help with partner shortlist?
Mateo R: on it. will share 8 names by EOD tomorrow.
Alex H: I'll draft the partner DM template for outreach. quick version below:```
Hey {{name}}, we are running a short design partners program to test Dedicated+Private rollout guardrails. 6-week engagement, we provide credits + SE time. Looking for folks comfortable sharing perf traces. Interested?
```
Zoe L: for measurement, let's define the eval metrics upfront: p50/p95 token latency, cost/token, fallback latency, success-rate-of-fallback. make sure eval job emits these.
Priya S: agree. also need an ethical/privacy checklist for partner data sharing (anonymization, expected retention). put that in the onboarding doc.
ops-bot: template checklist created: `dp-onboard-checklist.md` -> includes NDA note, KMS handling, trace redaction steps.
Jamal K: recruitment capacity — SEs available for partner work? we have 2x SEs for June window. is that enough?
Priya S: probably borderline. we'll cap partners at 6 to keep load manageable. if we get extra interest, put them on a waitlist for next cohort.
Mateo R: quick ask: can we add an A/B rollout plan for one partner to test canary weight ramping? want to test 1%, 5%, 25%, 100% over days with automatic rollback on error rate bump.
Alex H: will sketch a canary policy config example and paste it in the onboarding doc.
Zoe L: once pilot ends, we need a one-pager for execs summarizing outcomes: adoption signals, top 3 ops issues, recommended product changes, go/no-go decision.
Priya S: great. I'll assemble recruitment assets (DM template, form, onboarding doc, eval suite) and post them in #product-dp-stash.
Mateo R: posting partner shortlist tomorrow.
Priya S: thanks all — next sync: short async status in two days and finalize recruitment list. :thumbsup:
